experiment: STARTS S1ALT23: stacked frozen S1 + PR88 ALT at N15 L=2 and L=3, Q=qL

hypothesis.one_sentence: Frozen S1 + exact PR88 block-ALT still beats S1JOINT on Nov3 energy at L=2 and at L=3 with Q=1024*L.
hypothesis.not: No S1/ALT retune. No extra budget. No S4/S8. No continuation. Not a GR patch.

frozen_from_PR83_88.S1JOINT: exact S1 joint IID C0: nstarts=1 TQA, split_cap(Q,1), ncal=4, A=25, live gain, last+Polyak, energy min, engine m2
frozen_from_PR83_88.S1ALT: exact PR88 alt_spsa.py: same TQA start, same C0 4 full-vector calibration probes (charged), same live gain, same last+Polyak. Odd k shared Uc/γ; even k SNAP shells/β. joint_prefix_K=0.

allocation.S1: One TQA start at that L. Full Q=1024*L per arm.
allocation.inclusive: All init, calibration, perturbations, candidates, failures inside Q. No free JOINT prefix.
allocation.cold: Each L fitted independently from TQA.

selection: Lowest counted candidate energy. F post hoc, never selects.

gate.pass: at each L, bootstrap 95% CI of mean(E_S1ALT - E_S1JOINT) lies entirely below 0
gate.otherwise: reject stacked S1+ALT at that L. Do not retune.
gate.nov3_vs_qaoa_s1alt: Reported separately per L. Mark a development energy-win candidate only if Nov3−QAOA mean Δ(E-E0)/N CI under S1ALT lies entirely below 0.
gate.gr: Do not patch GR even if gates pass.
